content.text:
All 18 playbook rules have been reviewed and submitted. Summary of our position:

**Critical**
- **LOL-CAP** (deviation): mutual caps exist but the floor is only $100,000 on 12 months' fees "paid", and IBM excludes all liability for loss of our records/data. We raised IBM's floor to USD 1M, deleted the data-loss exclusion and added Excluded Claims (confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP).
- **INDEMN** (deviation): IBM's indemnity is IP-only with a 12-month credit as its "entire obligation", while ours covers any Services Recipient claim indirectly related to the Services. We added IBM limbs (breach of law, data breach, gross negligence/wilful misconduct) and deleted the open-ended Customer limb.
- **IP** (deviation): Materials default to IBM-owned Type II with an Enterprise-only licence back and no Customer-data ownership statement. Flipped the default to Type I and added a data ownership sentence.

**High**
- **T4C** (deviation): one-month convenience right is fine, but early termination charges are uncapped — capped at 3 months' fees plus prepaid-fee refund.
- **ASSIGN** (deviation): one-way consent restriction, no affiliate carve-out, IBM unrestricted — made mutual, added affiliate/successor carve-out and no change-of-control right.
- **LICENSE** (deviation): grant is revocable and excludes affiliates/contractors — fixed.
- **LD** (deviation): uncapped termination charges are the only Customer-payable penalty; confirmed as the sole amount.
- **NONCOMPETE** (compliant).

**Medium/low**
- **RENEWAL** (deviation): renewal repeats prior term with a 90-day window — set to 12 months / 30 days.
- **WARRANTY** (deviation): no conformance warranty or remedy plus "AS IS" Materials — added 90-day warranty and carved it out of the disclaimer.
- **AUDIT** (deviation): unlimited, unnoticed investigation right — added frequency/notice/cost/no-system-access limits.
- **TRANSITION** and **INSURANCE** (missing): inserted data return/transition assistance in 3.5 and an insurance clause in Article 14.
- **GOVLAW**, **EXCLUSIVITY**, **MFN**, **NOSOLICIT**, **MINCOMMIT** (compliant) — note MINCOMMIT should be re-checked against Attachment A and the Service Option Attachments, which are not in this document.
